name: readerly
description: A theme for book blogs, author websites and reading logs, in a light style (Paper) and a dark style (Lamplight).

color_scheme.description: Paper is light and Lamplight is dark. Auto follows each reader's system setting.

style_toggle.description: Show a button in the header that switches between Paper and Lamplight.

footer_about.description: One or two sentences under the site title in the footer.

secondary_navigation_title.description: Heading of the secondary navigation in the footer.

copyright_note.description: Text after the copyright line, for example: All reviews are my own.

intro_heading.description: Wrap words in *asterisks* to set them in italics. Leave empty to hide the introduction.

intro_button_text.description: Links to your newest post. Leave empty to hide the button.

show_currently_reading.description: Books tagged #reading, when there are any.

newsletter_heading.description: Shown when your site has signups turned on.
